dogecoin.text: @Payoneer Before our parent company is involved with another payment mediator, they need to know if Payoneer endorses and deals with bitcoin, dogecoin, etc. If so? We will have NO part of you. Thank you.

@Payoneer Great. Our parent company's office will be more than happy to be in touch then to discuss our beginning mutual cooperation with Payoneer as one of our financial mediators or liaisons. With the proviso Payoneer does not support bitcoin, dogecoin, or any cryptocurrency. Thank you.
